source.title: IrelandElection.com, 2016 Seanad Election: National University of Ireland
source.check: The count is IrelandElection.com's; the first preferences add up to the valid poll and the 3 winners fill the seats. Each winner was checked against the Houses of the Oireachtas list of the members of the 25th Seanad for this constituency (api.oireachtas.ie, seanad-build, Nov 2026).

franchise: the university's graduates who are Irish citizens and registered (Seanad Electoral (University Members) Act 1937)
sourceNote: Filed under 2016-04-25, the day the Houses of the Oireachtas give as the start of the 25th Seanad; a Seanad general election is held by post, and its polls close over several days.
